claims.text: Boxed warning: severe hyponatremia can cause seizures, coma, respiratory arrest or death.
claims.quote: DDAVP can cause hyponatremia. Severe hyponatremia can be life-threatening, leading to seizures, coma, respiratory arrest, or death

claims.text: CI: high risk of severe hyponatremia, eg, excessive fluid intake, fluid/electrolyte-disturbing illness, loop diuretics, systemic or inhaled glucocorticoids.
claims.quote: DDAVP is contraindicated in patients at increased risk of severe hyponatremia, such as patients with excessive fluid intake, illnesses that can cause fluid or electrolyte imbalances, and in those using loop diuretics or systemic or inhaled glucocorticoids

claims.text: Sodium must be normal before starting; recheck within 7 days and about 1 month after starting, then periodically.
claims.quote: Ensure the serum sodium concentration is normal before starting or resuming DDAVP. Measure serum sodium within 7 days and approximately 1 month after initiating therapy, and periodically during treatment.
For All Patients Receiving Repeated Doses: Restrict free water intake and monitor for hyponatremia.
